use default

union LinkedList is
    NODE(value: int, next: LinkedList mut)
    EMPTY
si

union Tree is
    BRANCH(
        value: int,
        left: Tree mut,
        right: Tree mut
    )
    LEAF
si

insert(tree: Tree, value: int) -> Tree =>
    if let (node_value, left, right): Tree.BRANCH = tree then
        if value < node_value then
            Tree.BRANCH(node_value, insert(left, value), right)
        else
            Tree.BRANCH(node_value, left, insert(right, value))
        fi
    else
        Tree.BRANCH(value, Tree.LEAF, Tree.LEAF)
    fi

build_tree(list: LinkedList) -> Tree is
    let tree: Tree mut = Tree.LEAF
    let cursor mut = list

    while let (value, next): LinkedList.NODE = cursor do
        tree = insert(tree, value)
        cursor = next
    od

    tree
si

in_order(tree: Tree) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[int] is
    if let (value, left, right): Tree.BRANCH = tree then
        yield in in_order(left)
        yield value
        yield in in_order(right)
    fi
